briefdescription.para: If we can prove the backedge is untaken, remove it.

detaileddescription.para: This destroys the loop, but leaves the (now trivially loop invariant) control flow and side effects (if any) in place.

briefdescription.para: Remove a loop if it is dead.

detaileddescription.para: A loop is considered dead either if it does not impact the observable behavior of the program other than finite running time, or if it is required to make progress by an attribute such as 'mustprogress' or 'llvm.loop.mustprogress' and does not make any. This may remove infinite loops that have been required to make progress.
This entire process relies pretty heavily on LoopSimplify form and LCSSA in order to make various safety checks work.

simplesect.para: true if any changes were made. This may mutate the loop even if it is unable to delete it due to hoisting trivially loop invariant instructions out of the loop.
